documents.name: mixed
documents.what: tables of strings, integers, reals, booleans and short arrays, as a configuration looks

documents.name: strings-plain
documents.what: strings of 64 to 4096 ASCII bytes, no escape

documents.name: strings-escape
documents.what: every byte of every string an escape: a line feed, a backslash, a quote, an e-acute, a character outside the first plane (a surrogate pair in JSON); entities in XML

documents.name: strings-utf8
documents.what: half the bytes non-ASCII, two-, three- and four-byte sequences mixed

documents.name: numbers-int
documents.what: integers of one to three digits, one a line or element

documents.name: numbers-edge
documents.what: the int64 limits and their neighbours, reals of 17 significant digits, the largest and smallest exponents, subnormals

documents.name: nest-deep
documents.what: tables or arrays 31 levels deep (CF_MAX_DEPTH 32 allows 31 inside the document), repeated

documents.name: array-huge
documents.what: one array of one-digit elements, as many as the size holds (INI: name[] = x lines, D-60)

documents.name: table-wide
documents.what: one table of unique short keys, as many as the size holds

documents.name: keys-prefix
documents.what: keys sharing a 200-byte prefix (under CF_KEY_MAX): quadratic time on crafted keys

documents.name: whitespace
documents.what: mostly blanks, newlines, indentation and comments, a value now and then

documents.name: many-tiny
documents.what: documents of 20 to 64 bytes, parsed one at a time from their own slice; measures what one parse costs to start and to end

documents.name: invalid-late
documents.what: a valid document with its one error in the last KiB: a stray ] (JSON), a tab indent (YAML), a duplicate key (TOML), a truncated last item (CBOR), a line with no = (INI), a mismatched end tag (XML); measures the time to refuse

documents.name: records
documents.what: P-1's records (docs/Performance.md, Large documents): strings of 40 to 240 bytes and, once in 64 records, of 16 to 64 KiB, escapes, non-ASCII, 8 to 31 small numbers, a chain of nested tables

documents.name: yaml-aliases
documents.what: YAML alone, 1 MiB: plain entries, then aliases of aliases nine levels deep; an outcome table, not a speed row
